shots.framing: ECU face lying sideways in wet sand
shots.desc: FIRST FRAME = this image, fully lit, no fade. Keeper lies cheek-down in wet sand, eyes closed, foam washing over the sand near the face. Dawn gold/pink light. Eyes flutter on 'Systems online', open slowly, iris rings light up amber. On 'Sand intrusion' grains slide off the cheek like water beads.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The charts said the island was empty.

lines.speaker: directive
lines.text: Systems online. Solar intake, optimal. Sand intrusion, none.

shots.framing: MS, Keeper sitting up in the shallows, looking around
shots.desc: Keeper pushes up to sitting, water streaming off. Turns head left, then right, scanning the empty shore. On 'Scanning' a translucent cyan HUD ring expands from Keeper across the beach. On 'zero' the ring fades out.

shots.framing: CU Keeper face
shots.desc: Reaction: brows rise slightly, then the INNER brows lift (worry); lips part; a slow blink; gaze drops to the sand, then drifts out to the empty horizon on the question.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Then who am I supposed to help?

shots.framing: EWS, tiny Keeper on an empty beach, island, endless ocean
shots.desc: Title card fades in over the image: FOR SOMEONE, SOMEDAY (elegant serif, letter-spaced), holds, fades out. Sun crests the horizon, light spreads over the water. Gulls drift. No dialogue.

shots.framing: MS Keeper standing, wind
shots.desc: Keeper stands, lifts face to the sun. On 'sun feeds me' the dark-blue solar cells on its shoulders catch a glint and shimmer. On 'sand can't get in' a gust throws sand at it; the sand slides right off its skin/clothes.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Day one. I don't need to eat. I don't need to sleep.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The sun feeds me, and the sand can't get in.

shots.framing: WS time-lapse
shots.desc: Keeper sits motionless on a rock; time-lapse: sun arcs across the sky, shadows sweep around, clouds race, day->dusk->day. Keeper never moves.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: So I have time. More time than I know what to do with.

lines.speaker: directive
lines.text: Recommendation: enter standby until people are detected.

shots.framing: MCU Keeper looking down at its own open hands
shots.desc: Keeper looks at its hands, slowly opening and closing them. On 'never are' gaze lifts. On 'Efficient isn't' a small sad smile, slight head shake, an exhale (shoulders drop).

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Efficient isn't the same as helpful.

shots.framing: insert, low angle
shots.desc: A small orange hermit crab (cream spiral shell) is stuck on its back at the tide line, legs wiggling helplessly. A wave froths closer. No dialogue.

shots.framing: MCU Keeper notices
shots.desc: Keeper glances down, eyes widen, brows shoot up, mouth opens; leans forward quickly.

shots.framing: insert, Keeper's fingers and the crab
shots.desc: Keeper's fingers gently flip the crab upright. It scurries a few steps, stops, eye-stalks swivel back to look at Keeper.

shots.framing: CU Keeper, head tilted
shots.desc: Half-smile, one eyebrow raised, head tilt; on 'practice' a soft laugh with eyes squinting (lower lids up). On 'Captain' it looks down warmly; the crab raises a claw (cut-in is fine).

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: It was stuck. It needed help. Close enough.

shots.framing: MCU Keeper looking at the horizon
shots.desc: Wind in hair. Determination grows: brows lower and straighten, chin lifts, eyes narrow slightly, small firm smile on 'whoever comes next'.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: If no one is here now...

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: then I'll help whoever comes next.

shots.framing: insert, cupped hands at a spring
shots.desc: Fresh water pours from a lip of rock into Keeper's cupped hands, overflowing and splashing (on 'pouring').

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I found fresh water, pouring out of the rocks.

shots.framing: insert, carving
shots.desc: Keeper carves into a flat stone with a sharp shell: an arrow and 'WATER 40 PACES' appear stroke by stroke, chips flying, timed across the line.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I carved the way to it, in stone.

shots.framing: MS two bushes
shots.desc: Two bushes: blue berries and red berries. Keeper sets a marked stone at each: a check mark + 'EAT' by the blue (on 'heal'), an X + 'NO' by the red (on 'hurt').

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I marked which berries heal, and which ones hurt.

shots.framing: WS time-lapse hut build
shots.desc: Hut build time-lapse: bamboo frame rises, palm-frond thatch layers on, a rain shower passes and the inside stays dry. Keeper moves fast in time-lapse.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I built a roof that doesn't leak.

shots.framing: WS then insert of map
shots.desc: Keeper stands waist-deep looking down at jagged coral under clear water; then a flat rock with a scratched map: island outline, reef as jagged marks, a safe channel arrow.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: And I mapped the reef, so no boat would ever break on it.

shots.framing: CU Keeper pausing mid-carve
shots.desc: Keeper's hand pauses. Eyes lower, a flicker of doubt (brows pinch), then the gaze lifts to the horizon and a firm small smile forms on 'Not yet'.

lines.speaker: directive
lines.text: None of this is being received.

shots.framing: WS island silhouette at night
shots.desc: Night. Stars, black ocean, island dark. Keeper stands on the rocky point, only its eyes glow. On 'a ship could pass' a distant ship's tiny light slides along the horizon, unaware, and vanishes.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: But at night, the island disappears.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: A ship could pass a mile away, and never know there was water here.

shots.framing: MCU Keeper opening chest panel
shots.desc: Keeper opens a panel on its chest: glowing gold-cyan power cells light its face from below. Brows knit, hesitation, hand trembles; it pulls one cell out (on 'shorten'). On 'stay awake forever' it looks at the cell; on 'The light does' it looks up toward the tower.

lines.speaker: directive
lines.text: Warning. Removing a power cell will shorten your operational life by sixty-one percent.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I don't need to stay awake forever.

shots.setting: night, stone tower on the point
shots.framing: WS low angle tower
shots.desc: A stacked-stone tower (cairn lighthouse) with a lantern housing on top. Keeper places the glowing cell in; light blooms, a warm beam begins to sweep across the sea. BIG music swell.

lines.speaker: directive
lines.text: For the record... that was not efficient.

shots.framing: CU Keeper lit by passing beam
shots.desc: Beam sweeps across Keeper's face periodically. Soft smile, eyes half-lidded, content.

shots.setting: same composition: hut, tower, palm sapling
shots.framing: WS time-lapse years
shots.desc: Day/night cycling fast; storms; the sapling grows into a tall palm; Keeper repairs the tower; clothes fade. On-screen log counter (HUD style) reads DAY 400, DAY 2,000, DAY 7,300 as each is spoken.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Day two thousand. Still no ships.

shots.framing: MCU Keeper sitting in hut doorway, rain
shots.desc: Rain pours. Keeper sits in the doorway, Captain the crab beside it. Raindrops run down its cheeks like tears. After 'Insufficient data' it closes its eyes, lips press together, shoulders drop.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Directive... if no one ever comes...

shots.framing: MS Keeper looking up at a tall palm tree
shots.desc: Morning light. Keeper stands, looks up at the tall palm it planted on day one (now towering).

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I planted that tree on my first day.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: It never knew who would sit in its shade. It just grew anyway.

shots.framing: CU Keeper realization
shots.desc: Realization: eyes lift, brows relax and rise gently, a slow small smile, eyes glisten.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Not only for the people who are here...

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: but for the ones who matter, before you've even met them.

shots.setting: dusk, base of the tower, facing the sea
shots.framing: MS Keeper sitting down to rest
shots.desc: Dusk. Keeper sits at the base of the tower facing the sea, Captain at its knee, beam sweeping overhead. On 'Keep the light on' it looks up at the beam; then its eye-glow dims, eyelids lower slowly, head bows. Then time-lapse: sand drifts over its shoulders, vines creep across, the beam keeps sweeping.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Keep the light on for me.

shots.framing: MS small fishing boat in big waves
shots.desc: Small wooden fishing boat tossed by huge waves, heavy rain, lightning flashes. Mira (girl, yellow raincoat) clings to the mast; Grandpa (white beard, navy knit cap) fights the tiller.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Hold on, Mira! Hold on to the mast!

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Out here? There's nothing out here...

shots.framing: CU Grandpa face lit by the passing beam
shots.desc: The warm beam sweeps across Grandpa's wet face; his eyes widen, mouth falls open, then a disbelieving smile.

shots.framing: WS boat passing between jagged rocks
shots.desc: The boat threads between jagged rocks; white-painted marker stones and a pole mark a safe channel, lit by the sweeping beam.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Rocks! But someone marked a path, look!

shots.framing: MS Mira kneeling at the carved stone
shots.desc: Boat beached behind. Mira traces the carved letters on the stone with a finger and reads, then jumps up and runs, counting.

shots.framing: MCU Grandpa drinking from cupped hands
shots.desc: Grandpa drinks from the spring from cupped hands, laughs and nearly cries with relief; looks around in wonder.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Someone made all this... for us?

shots.framing: MCU Mira reading a carved stone on the wall
shots.desc: Inside the dry hut, a carved stone hangs on the wall: IF YOU ARE READING THIS, YOU ARE NOT ALONE. Mira reads it aloud slowly; her lip trembles, eyes fill.

shots.framing: WS Mira and Grandpa approach the dormant Keeper
shots.desc: Keeper sits at the tower base, half-buried in sand, vines across it, old Captain the crab on its knee. Mira approaches carefully; Grandpa reaches out a hand to stop her.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: It's okay. I think... it's been waiting.

shots.framing: insert, Mira's hand brushing the shoulder
shots.desc: Mira's small hand brushes sand and leaves off the dusty solar cells on Keeper's shoulder. Sunlight hits them; they gleam; a soft chime.

shots.framing: ECU Keeper eyes
shots.desc: The amber iris ring flickers, relights; lids lift; pupils focus on Mira.

shots.framing: CU Keeper face
shots.desc: Brows lift, lips part, slight tremble, eyes glisten; hoarse voice.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Are you hurt? There's water, forty paces north...

shots.framing: CU Mira smiling with wet eyes
shots.desc: Mira smiles through tears, nods.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: We found it. We found everything.

shots.framing: CU Keeper looks up at the tower, then back
shots.desc: Keeper's eyes rise to the lantern above, then return to Mira; brows tilt up in the middle, lips quiver.

shots.framing: two-shot, Mira takes Keeper's hand
shots.desc: Mira takes Keeper's hand in both of hers. Keeper's face: moved, a slow smile, eyelids lower, a drop slides down its cheek.

shots.framing: MCU Grandpa, cap in hand; then CU Keeper
shots.desc: Grandpa has taken off his cap, holds it at his chest. Keeper answers, looking at Mira on 'getting ready'.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: How long were you waiting out here?

shots.framing: alternating CUs Mira / Keeper
shots.desc: Name exchange. Mira earnest; Keeper a little shy; final smile with eyes closing briefly on 'Keeper.'

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: I never needed one. There was no one to call me anything.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Then you're Keeper. 'Cause you kept the light on.

shots.setting: dusk, years later, point with tower
shots.framing: WS tower, boats moored, two silhouettes
shots.desc: Dusk years later: tower beam sweeping, a few boats moored in the cove, gardens; Keeper and Mira (older) silhouetted on the point, Captain at their feet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I was nine years old the night we followed that light.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The charts don't say the island is empty anymore.

shots.framing: slow push toward the horizon, the beam passing overhead
shots.desc: Slow push over the water toward the horizon as the beam sweeps out across the sea, a far boat light answers. Final title FOR SOMEONE, SOMEDAY appears on the last line and holds (do not fade to black).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So if you're on an island of your own right now...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: doing good that no one has seen yet...
